_comment: Pairing of wearable channels to reference (BIOPAC) channels. Built for the mock streams; adapt stream names/channels/units to the REAL BIOPAC inventory (validation/stream_inventory.json) once captured. 'channel' may be an integer index or a channel label (matched against the stream's XML channel labels). 'scale_reference_to_wearable' multiplies the reference signal so its units match the wearable before computing scale-sensitive metrics (CCC/ICC/Bland-Altman); use 1.0 when units already match.
